newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower, losses trimmed late.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower, losses trimmed late.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed lower, but commercial buying late in the session brought contracts off session lows, traders said.
Profit-taking after recent firm gains plus declines in CBOT corn and wheat induced selling much of the day in MGE wheat, traders said.

However, traders said they doubt MGE wheat futures will fall much more Thursday because a tour through North Dakota's wheat areas on Wednesday found greater instances of disease and drought-stress to spring wheat.
"I don't think we will break much until we get results from that tour," one trader said.
The tour concludes late Thursday when participants are expected to release a report on their findings.
Atwood Larsen and Country Hedging were featured buying September, while Benson Quinn and Cargill Investor Services were leading sellers, traders said.
MGE spring wheat futures closed down 2-1/4 to 1/4 cent with September off 1-3/4 cents at $3.56-1/4 per bushel.
MGE white wheat futures closed down three to two cents with September off three at $4.06.
MGE spring wheat estimated volume was 17.389 million bushels and white wheat volume was 85,000 bushels.
